item.content:encoded:
Sexual content on the main wiki is here to stay and I'm not gonna be the one trying to give everyone a headache by saying it needs to go. All I'm saying is, the slightest of forewarning would hurt no one.

I used to hold this opinion (and this tale used to have a warning) but then there was a massive discussion on O5 and in IRC a few months ago. I flipped my opinion after realizing that when there are no "warnings" for, say, graphic depictions of violence and gore in longstanding and popular horror tales, there should be no warning for sex. This wiki is filled to the brim with graphic content. It always has been. Sex should be no exception.

I believe that pages with NSFW images should have a warning (such as the thing Vacuum linked below… which I'm pretty sure also is toeing the line of Wikidot's nudity rules?) but text is not something that your boss can look over your shoulder at and immediately recognize as NSFW. It's text. There are dozens of lines of it on the page. If someone realizes that the paragraph turned NSFW, they can stop reading. It's not an all-at-once shock like seeing a NSFW image is.

item.content:encoded:
No idea what "supposed to be there" means. Like, no shit it's supposed to be there, you wrote a sex scene. Sex scenes, much like sex itself, don't happen on accident.

I stayed out of the conversation on whether or not explicit material should be allowed on the wiki because I didn't want to alienate myself from anyone, but my biggest argument against explicit depictions of sex on the wiki would be that most folks don't read site fiction expecting such material, and folks might stumble onto something NSFW unexpectedly. It seems that this was the case with this person.

I mean, for the first 7 or so years of the site's history, anything involving sex besides sexual horror wasn't heard of on the site. So now that folks are writing sexually explicit stuff that's not meant to horrify, it's just part of the story, it sticks out. And someone could be casually, idly reading the wiki and then BAM!, "dick hanging limply out of his pants" and titties everywhere.

At this point, whether sexual content should be allowed on the site is an argument that's already been settled (verdict being, "yeah, sure, why not?"). The adult tag really doesn't mean much if someone comes to this story from, say, Recent Forum posts or your author page or something with no forewarning that this is a story that has a dude banging a hallucinated version of a skip.

Tl;dr: maybe an nsfw warning at the top like Clef has in The Flesh That Mates?

item.title: author post
item.content:encoded:
Unless otherwise stated, any graphics or images in my articles are made and/or taken by me.

"I couldn't breathe if I tried;
I lay my head on the floor,
my beating heart wanting more.
But I'll keep it in and keep you out;
I'm drowning, I'm drowning.
I'm drowning, I'm drowning."

In a post in SCP-2708's comments, I said: "Is reality what we perceive or what others perceive? If you yourself feel and see something as being real, and you believe it's real, couldn't you argue that it is real, even if observers disagree? Are the baseline parameters of reality personal or public?" This tale aims to explore that, and is likely the conclusion of the Baby's Guide/2708 setting.1

I'm not a huge fan of the bixby character (she's one of my old characters from my 'personal canon' as we call it, and I was originally planning on not using her in anything on the site), and I tried to make her as minimally present as possible while still making her seem like at least a little more than just a plot device. I did however refrain from revealing her item number anywhere in the tale just in case I ever want to actually write her, but human skips are a pain in the ass to write as SCP articles, so I probably won't.

+ show up-front explanation of events/spoilers
- collapse

Firstly, you gotta read SCP-2708 - it's part of the series, despite being an SCP article rather than a tale.

So, in Baby's Guide, it's established through implication that Dr. ████ ███████ (Adam Leeward) got someone pregnant, and the note at the end implies that that person is in containment, and thus, he's in pretty deep shit. However, in SCP-2708, we see that "subjects affected claim to be capable of full interaction with [2708-A] as if it were a human partner, up to and including realistic perception of facial feature details and general appearance, realistic perception of physical stimulation, and, in one case, even a perceived full-term pregnancy."

So basically, we have Leeward self-aware of the fact that he's attracted to Aline and we have him take the proper actions to prevent said attraction, but he's also been affected by 2708 for an indeterminate amount of time - long enough for him to convince himself that there's a baby coming - while this is going on, and he starts to see Aline in 2708-A and vice versa, until he's too confused to comprehend it and realizes something's completely off while staring at himself in the mirror.

The title is just a pun on the fact that he has trouble processing emotion - just like AWCY warned us regarding Foundation employees in 2708's end note.

In summary: This won't be for everyone, for the little bit of NSFW content or for the length or for the sappiness or for anything otherwise, and I respect that. And for reviews, thank you to: …no one/everyone. We've got another coldpost on our hands, lads.

Edit: If you notice the adult tag, yeah, there's one scene in there. Personally I don't think it's long enough or vulgar enough to warrant a warning at the top of the page (there are a few in the tag without warnings), but if anyone thinks otherwise please let me know.

Footnotes
1. And yes, I was trying to come up with a way to make this tale's title "'Baby's First Guide to Safe-Class Anomalies' & Other Questionable Documents Recovered from the Hard Drive of Dr. ████ ███████" but it simply could not work for contextual and tonal reasons. Oh well.
